product: Sound Recording apparatus for modes of payments, Sound Recording apparatus, like dj turntable, Sound recorders

predecessors.note: Telephone answering machines were dropped as a separate line and now sit across the rest of heading 8519.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.

definitionShare.basis: The heading figure is Comtrade's own aggregate at this level, covering every six-digit line in the heading. The defined figure is the sum of the HStat product lines inside it. The gap is the part of the heading the sector definition does not track.
definitionShare.caution: Summed values omit any member whose own period failed coverage validation, so the share is a lower bound where members are missing.
